reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face and returned-note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source has a strict left-facing profile with only the profile-side eye visible. The return rotates the head toward the viewer into a three-quarter view with a clearly exposed second eye and a broader visible front plane. Restore the strict left-facing profile and leftward gaze without adding the far eye.

The return invents a circular gray pin/seal above the note marks and expands the original compact upper marks into three rows with multiple groups. The source has no such circular object and only its original small upper-mark footprint. Remove the pin/seal and added third row/groups, restoring only the source-scale compact marks and largely blank lower paper.
entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown, very short dark-brown/gray side and back hair, short sideburn and one dark visible eyebrow remain. No moustache, beard or clearly added eyewear is visible, and there is one closed mouth. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder braid, pale metallic collar patches, one dark-bordered pale neck cross and a compact cluster of breast decorations partly beside the note. The rounded lower head meets a short broad high collar without a long stalk. The complete tilted frame, opaque pale warm grey-beige backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. These positives do not offset the pose rotation and added note content.
entries.visible_limitations: A possible tiny eyewear/temple detail, individual breast decorations, collar symbols and note lettering are unresolved at 65x67; none is an additional rejection reason. The far-eye exposure and added circular object/third note row are clearly visible in native crops.
